summary.name: Flow AI Video
summary.one_liner: Flow AI Video (flowaivideo.org) is a browser-based AI video generator that creates short videos from text prompts or images, with claimed 4K output and multi-shot consistency.
use_cases: Creating marketing clips from text prompts
Turning a still image into a short animated video
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a web-based workflow: enter a text prompt or upload an image, press generate, then review and download the result as MP4. It states support for text-to-video and image-to-video, and claims 4K output with multi-shot consistency across scene transitions. It mentions Veo 3 and Veo 3.1 models on the generator, and the pricing section also lists Sora 2, Seedance and Wan 2.5 models for yearly plans. Video generation consumes credits based on duration and resolution. Access is through any modern browser, including smartphone browsers; no standalone mobile app is available yet.
notable: Text-to-video and image-to-video generation with claimed native 4K output
Multi-shot storytelling claimed to keep characters and style consistent across scenes
Credit-based plans with free starting credits and commercial use license on paid plans
Browser-only access with no download; standalone mobile app not yet available
caveats: Paid subscriptions required for many models and features; several models (Veo 3, Sora 2, Seedance, Wan 2.5) and no watermark are listed as yearly-plan only
Free users receive limited starting credits; subscription plans provide monthly credits
Page uses heavy promotional language and unverified claims such as 99.5% success rate and 2-second generation time
Cancellation is handled through a support email address
